items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: And you see Sharky standing on the corner listening in, see.

ctx.x: Yeah, they say Sharky used to follow Rene.

That's correct. Right on this new man in Claiborne, see. He just had this sabotaging on Sunday evening and the two bands would meet there, see. And you see Sharky standing on the corner listening in, see. That's facts. I'll tell you facts.

Yeah. You remember seeing him then? I remember. Do you notice anything in Sharky's style that reminds you at all of... Rene. Kid Rene, yeah. Do you notice any of Rene in Sharky's style? Yeah, he has a lot of... Oh, he do? Yeah, he has a lot of... Do you think he comes fairly close?
